requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests that verify providers are ranked in descending order based on computed comparison scores.
The system must include unit tests that validate consistent ranking results for identical input across multiple executions.
The system must include tests that verify correct handling of tied scores, ensuring deterministic ordering or explicit tie indicators.
The system must include tests that validate behavior when one or more providers have missing or null scores.
The system must include schema validation tests ensuring comparison responses conform to the defined Pydantic models.
The system must include integration tests verifying that the evaluate_care_facade correctly orchestrates comparison requests and returns structured responses.
The system must include integration tests confirming that the tool_router correctly exposes and invokes the comparison capability.
The system must include tests verifying that measure breakdowns are present and correctly associated with each provider in the response.
The system must include tests ensuring strengths and weaknesses are generated and mapped to the correct provider.
The system must include tests validating that invalid input schemas (e.g., missing provider IDs) raise validation errors.
The system must include tests verifying that empty provider lists are rejected or handled according to defined API behavior.
The system must include tests confirming that comparison results include all requested providers with no unintended omissions.
The system must include tests ensuring normalization logic produces comparable scores across providers with different measure availability.
The system must include integration tests validating end-to-end flow from tool invocation to response serialization.
The system must include tests confirming that API responses are serializable to JSON without errors.
The system must include tests ensuring that large input sets (e.g., multiple providers) do not break ranking or response structure.
The system must include tests validating that the comparison tool returns consistent output format for LLM consumption.
The system must include tests ensuring that comparison outputs contain explicit ranking positions for each provider.
The system must include tests verifying that error conditions in underlying scoring services are propagated or handled gracefully in comparison responses.
The system must include tests ensuring that duplicate provider inputs are handled according to defined behavior (deduplicated or rejected).
